request.style: English, soul, deep male baritone solo with background choir, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, soft strings, warm and reverent mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He was about thirty when the work began
As it was supposed, he carried the name
Son of Heli, son of Matthat, son of Levi
Walking the path that the ancestors knew
From Melchi to Jannai, the line is drawn
Through Joseph and Mattathias, the story grows
Amos and Nahum, Esli and Naggai
Maath and Mattathias, names in the snow

[Chorus]
The son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa
The son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel
The son of Neri, the link in the chain
From David's throne to the Messiah's name

[Verse]
Zerubbabel led the people home
From Babylon's shadow, from exile and grief
He rebuilt the altar for the God of Israel
Offering burnt offerings, keeping the belief
Jeshua and the priests stood side by side
Following the Law of Moses, the man of God
Shealtiel stood with his kinsmen in the work
Preserving the hope of the ancient cord

[Chorus]
The son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa
The son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel
The son of Neri, the link in the chain
From David's throne to the Messiah's name

[Bridge]
After the exile, Jechoniah is named
He fathered Shealtiel, who raised Zerubbabel
A thread unbroken through the darkened days
God's faithfulness holds the royal ways

[Chorus]
The son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa
The son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel
The son of Neri, the link in the chain
From David's throne to the Messiah's name

[Outro]
The son of Neri, written in the book
A witness to the promise, never to break
